title: Resolution urging Albany to raise e-scooter hit-and-run penalties
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.1679/S.561, which would increase penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an e-scooter. It would raise the second-degree offense from a violation to a Class A misdemeanor and the first-degree offense from a Class B misdemeanor to a Class E felony. The Council also urges the State Legislature to extend these increased penalties to cover e-bikes.
